The design process will involve collaboration with the client to understand their vision, followed by the creation of visually appealing layouts that incorporate the QR codes in a stylish manner. The final product will be delivered in both digital and print-ready formats, ensuring versatility for various distribution methods. This innovative approach to invitation design will enhance guest engagement and set the stage for a memorable event.
